command.description: Supported CleanCore command names. Payload shape depends on command.

AgentResourceCreateRequest.description: Creates the agent asset shell. Skill definitions and exported tools are not required here; add them later with /v1/agents/{agent_id}/skills, /v1/agents/{agent_id}/exported-tools, or through an AgentPackage draft. Optional tool_bindings only configure which tools the agent may use.

version.description: Optional package draft version to create together with the asset.

tool_bindings.description: Optional allow/deny config for tools this agent may use; this does not create tool manifests and is not required for agent creation.

approval_id.description: Approved runtime_hook_binding approval id used to retry a binding upsert that requires approval.

agent_version.description: Agent package version whose prompt profile should become the default.

draft_id.description: When supplied, patch an AgentPackage draft instead of the standalone active profile.

agent_version.description: Agent version the standalone prompt profile should apply to.
Agent package version whose tool bindings should become the default.

draft_id.description: When supplied, patch an AgentPackage draft instead of the standalone active tool bindings.

agent_version.description: Agent version the standalone tool bindings should apply to.
Agent package version containing the named skill.

draft_id.description: When supplied, patch an AgentPackage draft instead of the standalone active skill.

agent_version.description: Agent version the standalone skill should apply to.

source_kind.description: release, draft, or standalone source kind such as profile, skill, tool_binding, collaborator, or exported_tool.

AgentExportedTool.description: A tool exported by an existing agent. tool_id is required for exported tool creation, not for /v1/agents asset creation.

agent_version.description: Agent package version containing the named collaborator.

draft_id.description: When supplied, patch an AgentPackage draft instead of the standalone active collaborator.

agent_version.description: Agent version the standalone collaborator should apply to.

AgentPackageSkillDraftPayload.description: Payload for creating or updating a skill under an existing agent. This is separate from agent asset creation, so skill_id is required here but not by /v1/agents.

draft_id.description: Required by agent.package.skill.* draft commands; optional for standalone skill REST upsert.
